    Do you want a quick visual tour?

    See how to add courses and projects, adjust the canvas and check your planning.

    Just show me the essentials
    1. Build your plan. Choose Calendar or List, complete your settings and acknowledge the notice. Required labels show which selections are still missing. Add courses and projects from the Course Catalog using + or drag onto the canvas. Use + Add unlisted course for courses outside the catalogue.
    2. Choose your view. Calendar helps with timing; List focuses on curriculum rules. Switching keeps your selection and timing. Automatic placements are marked Proposed until confirmed or adjusted.
    3. Complete Approval. From 120 EC, go to Approval. Complete personal details, project hosts and topics, and resolve requirements or request exceptions where offered. Back to Build preserves your information.
    4. Save and export. Save build and Open build keep both steps in one file. Export PDF produces a planning overview. Export for approval produces the final approval PDF with signature fields once the requirements are complete.
    5. Find help. Use ? and i for contextual instructions. Clicking a hatched project segment opens leave settings.

    Build actions

    Course Catalog

    Course details

    Choose your view

    Calendar: plan your curriculum across the two academic years. Use it to see teaching periods, move courses and projects, and understand timing warnings such as overlap or high workload.

    List: review your selected courses and projects by category, compare credits and check curriculum requirements. You can open course settings here too.

    You can switch views at any time. Both show the same planning and lead to the Approval step.

    Add and adjust courses & projects

    • Add a course or project: use its + button, or drag it from the Course Catalog onto the canvas. Principles courses, Research and academic skills and courses required for your specialisation go straight to Year 1; in List, other regular courses are placed in the year that creates fewer warnings. Projects and theses offer a year choice.
    • Add an unlisted course: use + Add unlisted course at the bottom of Elective space in the Course Catalog, enter the required course information and choose its year and teaching period(s).
    • Move a course or project: drag it across years on the canvas. Research projects and literature theses can also move between their permitted periods or starting months. Standard courses stay in their teaching period.
    • Find a category: click its colored label in the canvas legend to open the matching category in the Course Catalog.
    • Check flexibility: click a placed course or project to see its course details and available placement options.
    • Adjust a project: use the pencil next to the Days per week or Scheduled break tile in its details. Click a hatched break on the canvas to go directly to the leave settings.

    On your phone, the + Add courses & projects button stays at the top while scrolling and opens the Course Catalog. Use Build actions for saving, opening and exporting. Tap a placed course to adjust its planning; use List or Calendar to choose your view.

    For Education, DDS courses belong in Year 1 and teacher-training courses in Year 2 at their fixed teaching periods. The 30 EC research major is full-time and may start in February, March or April of Year 1.

    Category information

    How should this course count?

    Education requires one constrained DDS choice. You can replace that choice, or keep it and add this course as a DDS elective. Each course counts only once.
